title: Lola
subtitle: Independent
description: Though her designation was L0-LA59, Princess Leia called her friendly Droid "Lola" and was always polite to her. Lola was Leia Organa's constant companion as she explored the grounds of the Royal Palace on Alderaan, and helped her out of more than one jam, even if Obi-Wan Kenobi had to put her back together again.
